name: STREAM-OWED-first-in-first-out
note: The queue spent in the order it was filled: the far ring a crossing lists first, and every pixel queued before a turn, are built before the near ones the governor waits on.

name: STREAM-OWED-later-of-two
note: Of two as near, the later: a sweep's rebuild jumps the crossing's list it was queued behind.

name: STREAM-OWED-let-go-kept
note: A pixel the stream let go is built whole and torn down again - land behind the traveller, paid for while the road ahead waits.

name: STREAM-OWED-standing-kept
note: A standing pixel stays on the queue and is taken as a build: a frame's turn of the pump spent on nothing, and the queue never empties of it.

name: STREAM-OWED-pump-shifts
note: The pump as it was - first in, first out, every let-go entry built: the ride the report met.

name: STREAM-OWED-governor-cuts-on-gain
note: Cut again at every settle while any of the hole stands, the stream gaining on it or not: one town on the road takes x40 to x1.

name: STREAM-OWED-governor-one-cut
note: One cut and no more until a climb: a hole that never shrinks holds the journey at half its pace, outrunning the land.

name: STREAM-OWED-governor-never-looks
note: The count at the last look never taken: nothing is ever fewer than it, and every settle cuts again.
